page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2.xlarge is a storage-oriented virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8163 processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 4 dedicated physical cores, 4 vCPUs, and 1 thread per core. It includes 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and comes bundled with 959 GB of local SSD storage. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the processing and memory performance of this instance in the lower percentiles. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests yielded scores of 1102.28 and 2922.29 respectively, both categorized in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only large block transfer rate of 19.71 GB/sec and a write large block rate of 18.31 GB/sec. Database operations and static web serving throughput are also on the lower end, with Passmark database operations scoring 1083.99 and static web serving throughput reaching 2.4 GB/sec.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.i2.xlarge offers high local storage density and a generous memory-to-vCPU ratio of 1:8, which provides qualitative cost efficiency for storage-heavy workloads that do not require high-performance compute. However, the tradeoff is lower CPU and memory throughput. This instance is best suited for legacy database hosting, moderate Redis caching, local file storage, and general-purpose workloads requiring significant local SSD capacity without intensive computational demands.
